text.card: A red giant 5,805 parsecs away, 19 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 13, give 1.03 solar masses and 18.6 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,550 K at its surface.
